reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Fear of heavy squats is common, and it's very trainable. We start lighter than feels necessary, make every rep a clean win, and add weight only when the last few felt controlled. Keep a notebook of what felt scary and how it went, because the number on the bar matters less than the confidence you build. Tell me your gym setup, how many days you can train, and whether anything physical is limiting you, and I'll build the program around that."}
